#+TITLE: ShowAllEntityData — Page Type Testing Reference
#+DATE: 2026-08-11
#+AUTHOR: generated by Claude Code

* Overview

This file enumerates every one of the 92 routable page types recognised by
=ShowAllEntityData.user.js=, as declared in the =pageDefinitions= array
(=ShowAllEntityData.user.js:11569-14271=) and gated by the four
=// @include= regexes in the userscript header. For each page type it gives
a real, clickable MusicBrainz URL (using live MBIDs looked up via the
MusicBrainz web service), the script's =tableMode=, the button(s) that
trigger it, and a plain-language summary of which script features actually
fire (column extractors, injected columns, collapsible cells, CAA/EAA
artwork, sticky columns, etc.).

Wherever the page type is tied to a specific entity, the entity is
Bruce Springsteen or something directly connected to him (his catalogue,
Columbia Records, The Stone Pony, New Jersey, ...). A handful of page types
are inherently global/editor-scoped (reports, elections, tag lookup,
genres, CD stubs, ISRC lookup, user-owned collections) and use real but
not-Springsteen-specific MusicBrainz identifiers instead — noted inline.
Two entries (=collections-releases= and every =user-*= page type) need an
identifier that belongs to a specific editor/collection; the editor
username =vzell= is used throughout since it is a real, publicly viewable
MusicBrainz account, but a real collection MBID could not be found by
search and is left as a =<collection-mbid>= placeholder.

* Page type details

** 1. taglookup
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/taglookup][/taglookup]]
- Match: ~path.includes('/taglookup')~
- Button: "Show all Releases for Tags"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised:
  - Column extractors: Name → CAA sort-key; Country/Date split; Tracks summed into "Total Tracks"; Format expanded into Format Types
  - Synthetic column: Date → Day/Month/Year parts
  - Injected "Relationships" column
  - Multi-row rendering + collapsible toggles on Label, Catalog#, Country/Date, CAA
  - CAA thumbnails next to Name; Name is the sticky/main column
  - =insertH2: 'Releases'=, =insertPrependH2: 'Searchform'=

** 2. cdtoc
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/cdtoc][/cdtoc]]
- Match: ~path.includes('/cdtoc')~
- Button: "Show all CDToc attached to Releases"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised:
  - Country/Date split, Date → D/M/Y synthetic columns
  - Injected "Relationships" column
  - Multi-row + collapsible on Label, Catalog#
  - CAA thumbnails next to Title; Title is sticky/main column

** 3. artist-credit-entity
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/artist-credit/2035305/release-groups][/artist-credit/AC_ID/release-groups]]
- Match: ~/\/artist-credit\/[^/]+\/.+/~ (must precede the plain =artist-credit= entry)
- Button: "Show all Artist-Credit Entities"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: converts the page's native list to a table (=listToTable=); separate column sets per entity kind for Release groups / Releases / Recordings sub-views

** 4. artist-credit
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/artist-credit/2035305][/artist-credit/AC_ID]]

- Button: "Show all Artist-Credit Uses"
- tableMode: multi
- Features exercised: =insertH2: 'Artist list'=, =listToTable=, per-entity-kind (Release groups/Releases/Recordings) column sets

** 5. user-subscriptions
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/user/vzell/subscriptions][/user/USER/subscriptions]]
- Match: ~/\/user\/.*\/subscriptions/~
- Buttons (rewrite the last path segment, not a query param): "🧮 Artist subscriptions" → =/user/USER/artist=; "🧮 Collection subscriptions" → =/collection=; "🧮 Label subscriptions" → =/label=; "🧮 Series subscriptions" → =/series=; "🧮 Editor subscriptions" → =/editor=
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: sticky/main column = Name

** 6. editor-subscribers

- Button: "Show all Editor Subscribers for User"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: =listToTable=

** 7. account-applications
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/account/applications][/account/applications]]
- Match: ~/\/account\/applications/~
- Button: "Show all Applications"
- tableMode: multi, non_paginated
- Features exercised: =groupByH3= (rows grouped per section heading)

its own heading), =listToTable: ['genres','tags']= (native =<ul>= genre/tag
lists converted into sortable tables), tableMode =multi=.
